value.rationale: This is a natural complete equality classification at the seven-row square threshold. It separates the only two qualitatively different optima—individual testing and the Fano projective-plane design—while giving the exact labeled count and stabilizers. The result is structurally stronger than a known construction or a maximum-size entry and is useful as a canonical small-parameter benchmark.
